representation: one physical page-local table and one printed report-context KV per page; year headings carried to observations

fields.years[].year: Year; decimal string repeated on all its observations
fields.years[].months[].month_number: excluded: redundant month ordinal; month label retained
fields.years[].*.source_page: provenance: supplied local-to-source map; record source_page
fields.document.year_range: excluded: derived summary; all year values retained
fields.document.title: Title; exact string
fields.document.notes[]: Notes; join in order with spaces
fields.document.source: Source; null becomes blank, no invention
